description.value: Once per round, make a Reflex save as a free action to catch a rock you would normally be hit by (Small DC 15, Medium DC 20, Large DC 25).

Once every 1d2 rounds, a thunder gigas can cause the ground to erupt around it within a 30-ft.-radius. Creatures within the area of effect take 8d6 points of earth damage and are inflicted with the Weighted status effect for 1d6 rounds. A successful Reflex save (DC 24) reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 23).

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 23).

description.value: 3/day, a thunder gigas roars an electrifying cone blast within 45-ft. burst. Any creature within the area of effect takes 15d6 points of lightning damage and are inflicted with the Static status effect for 1d6 rounds. A successful Reflex save (DC 24) reduces the damage by half and negates the status effect. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 6th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 27).

effect: Static for [[1d6]] rounds. Prose describes a cone; also calls the 45-ft area a burst.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 6th level spell (Knowledge: Local DC 27).

description.value: Thunder Gigas are proficient with all simple and all martial weapons
Thunder Gigas can breathe water as well as air.
